questions.q: You are predicting churn for the first half of 2024. Where should the cutoff date filter go so customers with no earlier orders still appear with zeros?
options: In a WHERE clause on the orders table
In the ON condition of a LEFT JOIN
In the SELECT list
In the ORDER BY clause
questions.explain: Putting the date in the LEFT JOIN's ON condition keeps every customer, with zero counts when no earlier orders match. A WHERE filter on the orders table would drop those customers.

questions.q: A model scores an AUC of 1.000 on the test set after you added a new feature. What is the most likely explanation?
options: The model is perfect and ready to deploy
The test set is too large
The feature leaks information from after the cutoff
Logistic regression always scores 1.0
questions.explain: In the lesson, a feature that included 2024 orders lifted AUC from 0.775 to 1.000. A perfect score usually means the feature contains the answer.

questions.q: What is true of the Redshift Data API?
options: It requires a persistent database connection
It only works for provisioned clusters
It returns results synchronously with no polling
It is asynchronous and needs no drivers or persistent connection
questions.explain: The Data API uses a secure HTTP endpoint and asynchronous calls, and works with both provisioned clusters and Redshift Serverless workgroups. You poll for status, then fetch results.

questions.q: By default, what format does Redshift's UNLOAD write?
options: Pipe-delimited text
Parquet
JSON
Excel
questions.explain: The docs state the default is pipe-delimited text. Add FORMAT AS PARQUET to write Parquet.

questions.q: Which service does Redshift ML use behind the scenes to train models, and what does that mean for cost?
options: Amazon Athena, so training is free
Amazon SageMaker AI, which has an additional associated cost
AWS Glue, billed per crawler
Nothing external; training is always free
questions.explain: Redshift ML trains with Amazon SageMaker AI. The docs say this has additional cost, which you can limit with settings such as MAX_RUNTIME and MAX_CELLS.
